info.name: Food Delivery API
info.description:
Food Delivery Platform API Collection - All endpoints for authentication (email/password + phone/OTP), restaurants, orders, couriers, consumer profiles, and platform management.

Includes:
- Email/Password Authentication
- Phone-based OTP Authentication for Consumers
- Consumer Profile Management
- Restaurant & Menu Management
- Order Management
- Courier Operations
- Referral Program
- Admin Analytics

item.name: Phone Authentication (OTP)
item.description: Phone-based authentication using OTP for consumers. Supports login and automatic signup.

request.description:
Send OTP verification code to phone number.

Phone format: Uzbekistan format (998XXXXXXXXX)

Rate limited: 5 OTPs per hour per phone number.

The response includes:
- expiresInSeconds: Time until OTP expires (default: 300s)
- isNewUser: Whether this phone number is already registered

Verify OTP code and authenticate.

If the phone number is new, a new user account is automatically created with CONSUMER role.

Returns JWT access and refresh tokens on success.

Max 3 verification attempts per OTP.

Resend OTP verification code.

Subject to rate limiting (5 per hour per phone).

Previous OTP codes are invalidated when a new one is sent.

item.name: Consumer Profile
item.description: Consumer profile management endpoints. Requires CONSUMER role.

request.description:
Get current consumer's profile.

Returns profile information including:
- Personal info (name, email, phone)
- Delivery address and coordinates
- Account status

Update current consumer's profile.

All fields are optional - only provided fields will be updated.

Fields that can be updated:
- firstName, lastName
- email (optional for phone-only users)
- address (delivery address)
- latitude, longitude (delivery coordinates)

Get consumer profile by ID.

Requires ADMIN or RESTAURANT_OWNER role.

Useful for restaurants to view customer information for orders.

item.name: Analytics

request.description:

Cache TTL: 1 minute

Cache TTL: 5 minutes

item.name: Financial Analytics
item.description: Financial analytics endpoints for GMV, commission revenue, delivery fees, promotions, payouts, and contribution margin. Requires ADMIN or PLATFORM role.

request.description: Calculate GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) metrics. GMV = Sum of all order values before deductions. Cache TTL: 60 seconds.
Calculate commission revenue metrics. Commission = Platform fee charged to restaurants per order. Cache TTL: 300 seconds.
Calculate delivery fee metrics. Tracks fees collected from customers and paid to couriers. Cache TTL: 120 seconds.
Calculate promotion and discount metrics. Tracks promotional costs and their effectiveness. Cache TTL: 300 seconds.
Calculate restaurant payout metrics. Net Payout = Gross - Commission - Subsidies - Promo Costs + Adjustments - Fees. Cache TTL: 300 seconds.
Calculate courier payout metrics. Courier Payout = Base Pay + Distance Bonus + Tips + Peak Bonus + Incentives. Cache TTL: 300 seconds.
Calculate contribution margin and unit economics. CM = Commission Revenue + Delivery Fee Revenue - Courier Costs - Promotion Costs. Cache TTL: 60 seconds.
Get high-level financial summary with key metrics. Cache TTL: 60 seconds.
Get GMV metrics for specific restaurants.
Get detailed payout information for a specific restaurant.
Get detailed payout information for a specific courier.
